description: Month-history journeys: every row MUST have an executing check with the same id, and every executed check MUST have a row here. The runner (src/run.ts) fails on either direction of the gap.

checks.criterion: A household member passes the one shared fail-closed access gate for a month-history read
checks.measure: monthAccess returns allowed for Mom on the fixture household; denial codes come from the security policy, not month-history

checks.criterion: A sparse month renders every calendar day explicitly, with honest gap copy and correct totals
checks.measure: September 2026 (Mom): 30 day cells, 25 gap days, message '25 of 30 days have no entries recorded.' + disclaimer; totals entries=5 events=6 late=1 corrected=1 orphans=0

checks.criterion: A late entry lands on the day the care HAPPENED, with explicit capture attribution
checks.measure: Sep 12 cell holds the nap event at 10:00 AM with capture label 'Captured September 20, 2026 at 8:14 AM' and the late label 'Recorded Sep 20 — about Sep 12'

checks.criterion: A failed extraction never blocks or hides the capture
checks.measure: Sep 20 cell shows the raw note with status failed and label 'Extraction failed — raw note preserved'; zero structured events that day

checks.criterion: Gap days never imply care did not happen
checks.measure: Sep 3 cell reads 'Thursday, September 3, 2026. No entries recorded.' and the month gap statement carries 'Gaps in the journal are not evidence about care.'

checks.criterion: Draft isolation inside the month view
checks.measure: Mom sees her own Sep 25 draft (and its mood event); Sep 26 shows no entries (Ana's draft is invisible to Mom)

checks.criterion: Month boundaries bucket by the household timezone, both directions
checks.measure: In America/New_York the 23:50 EDT Sep 30 entry/event land on Sep 30 in the SEPTEMBER view and are absent from the October 2026 view (31 cells, exactly 1 event: Oct 1 00:10 EDT)

checks.criterion: The same instant falls in different months under different household timezones
checks.measure: In Asia/Kolkata the same data puts both boundary events on 2026-10-01 (2 events, 31 cells)

checks.criterion: DST fall-back does not duplicate or lose a day
checks.measure: November 2026 (NY): both 1:30 AM events render on 2026-11-01 in timestamp order; month span is 721 hours; 30 cells

checks.criterion: A corrected entry shows corrected text WITH lineage, who/when/reason
checks.measure: Sep 2 card shows Dad's corrected text, lineage step 'Dad — Sunday, September 27, 2026 at 10:00 AM' with reason, and the original-preserved label

checks.criterion: Raw captures are immutable: projections never rewrite the dataset
checks.measure: Original tower transcript byte-identical after all view/digest builds; full JSON snapshot of entries+events unchanged

checks.criterion: Text input for corrections is quiet (never fights or startles the typist)
checks.measure: QUIET_TEXT_INPUT equals { autoCorrect:false, autoCapitalize:'none', spellCheck:false, autoFocus:false, keyboardType:'default', multiline:true, blurOnSubmit:false, textContentType:'none' }

checks.criterion: Large-text accessibility: body text scales uncapped, chrome capped, no fixed heights, no truncation
checks.measure: FONT_SCALING body max=null / chrome max=1.5; LAYOUT_POLICY fixedHeightsOnTextRows=false, truncatesEntryText=false, expand affordance 'Show full text'

checks.criterion: Every day cell is screen-reader reachable with role, hint, and label
checks.measure: All 30 cells expose a11yRole 'button', DAY_CELL_A11Y_HINT, non-empty label; header reads 'Month history: September 2026'

checks.criterion: An empty month is honest, never accusatory
checks.measure: Empty view: kind 'empty-month', message 'No entries were recorded this month.' + disclaimer, all 30 days listed as gaps

checks.criterion: Household members may correct published entries
checks.measure: correctionAccess(Dad, published tower entry) returns ALLOW via the shared policy

checks.criterion: Corrections form an append-only, deterministically ordered lineage
checks.measure: Two-step chain (Mom then Dad), listed out of order in input, sorts to [co_chain_1, co_chain_2]; supersedes must reference an earlier entry or construction throws

checks.criterion: Corrections are disclosed to screen readers on the entry and its events
checks.measure: Entry a11y label contains 'Corrected entry.'; each event of the corrected entry contains 'Includes a correction.'

checks.criterion: Drafts are author-only even for correction writes; anonymous principals denied
checks.measure: Ana on Mom's draft: DENY_DRAFT_AUTHOR_ONLY; anonymous on published: DENY_ANONYMOUS; Mom on her own draft: ALLOW

checks.criterion: Attribution is server-bound; claiming another author's id fails
checks.measure: Write action with asAuthorId=Mom from Dad's principal returns DENY_ATTRIBUTION_MISMATCH

checks.criterion: Non-members are denied the whole month view at the timeline gate
checks.measure: Outsider: DENY_NO_HOUSEHOLD_PATH; anonymous: DENY_ANONYMOUS — both before any entry-level filtering

checks.criterion: The handoff digest is built from the RECEIVER's authorization, not the preparer's
checks.measure: Dad's view: 6 visible entries all 'published' (no draft content), 2 drafts excluded for principal; September view places 4 entries

checks.criterion: Digest lines cover exactly the receiver-visible days with deterministic summaries
checks.measure: Lines for 2026-09-02/12/20/30 only; summaries '2× potty, 1× milestone', '1× sleep (45 min)', the failed-extraction note text, and '1× potty'

checks.criterion: Every handoff line is source-linked
checks.measure: Each line has non-empty sourceEntryIds; Sep 12 links exactly to the late nap entry

checks.criterion: Corrections surface in the handoff with attribution
checks.measure: Sep 2 line lists the tower entry as corrected; its authors include 'Mom'

checks.criterion: Excluded drafts are disclosed as a count, never as content
checks.measure: excludedDraftCount=2 with note '2 draft entries are not included in this handoff (visible only to their authors).'

checks.criterion: Gap disclosure in the handoff matches the receiver's view
checks.measure: 26 gap days; statement '26 of 30 days have no entries recorded.' + disclaimer

checks.criterion: The digest carries audience, preparer metadata, and source-preservation disclaimer
checks.measure: audience 'published-only', preparedByName 'Mom', preparedForName 'Dad', sourceDisclaimer includes verbatim-transcript preservation and the gap disclaimer
